job.title: CRUSHING & RECYCLING PLANT OPERATOR
job.description:
About the role
Our client, based in the EASTERN, Suburbs, are industry leaders in the field of recycling products and currently require a competent Concrete crushing and recycling Plant Operator to join their team. The role will involve the operation of various Plant Machinery, this is a Monday to Friday morning shift position with occasional overtime/weekend work expected. 

Duties 
•Operate the crusher, screens, conveyors and associated feed and stockpile equipment, managing stockpiles,
•Coordinate loader and excavator operators to maintain consistent feed to the crusher and manage stockpiles.
•Identify and sort incoming material (concrete, asphalt, brick, steel reinforcement) and manage contamination removal.
•Start up, shut down, and carry out routine operational checks on plant and mobile equipment.
•Conduct daily pre-start and operational inspections of plant, conveyors, and mobile equipment.
•Front end loader WA 500 Komatsu (tickets essential)
•Bobcat, Excavator,(tickets essential)
•Previous experience working in recycling yard or sand / quarry experience advantageous
•Loading/unloading trucks and Trailor
•Available Immediately

Experience required:
•Minimum 3–5 years experience in a Recycling / Quarry / Mobile crushing environment
•Strong knowledge of crushers, screens, conveyors and associated plant, with solid fault-finding and preventative maintenance experience
•Operating mobile plant, including loaders, excavators and water carts (relevant tickets required)
•Strong communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

How to apply
Should you or someone you know be in the market for a new opportunity, please do not hesitate in contacting Capture Recruitment on 9369 4459 (Monday to Friday 8.30am-5pm) or alternatively “APPLY NOW” with an updated resume

job.title: Toolmaker / Wire EDM Operator
job.description:
Capture Recruitment is currently seeking an experienced Toolmaker / Wire EDM Operator for a precision manufacturing business based in Airport West.

This role is suited to someone with hands on experience across Wire EDM, tool making, moulds, dies, jigs, fixtures, gauges, CNC machining and precision component work. Qualified Toolmakers, Fitter Machinists, Tool and Die Makers, and experienced Wire EDM Operators are encouraged to apply. 

Benefits
• Excellent hourly rate
• Full time, ongoing role
• Day shift hours
• Free on site parking available
• Immediate start available for the right person
• Opportunities for career advancement
• Free ongoing training offered

Duties

• Set up and operate Wire EDM machinery for precision cutting and tooling work
• Manufacture, repair and modify dies, moulds, jigs, fixtures, gauges and tool room components
• Read and interpret engineering drawings, tolerances, job sheets and technical specifications
• Complete machine setup, work holding, wire selection and cutting parameters.
• Inspect finished components using verniers, micrometers and gauges 
• Maintain safe work practices and keep machinery, tools and work areas clean and organised
• Carry out basic CNC machining, manual machining, grinding, fitting and general tool room duties as required

Requirements

• Experience operating Wire EDM machines
• Trade background as a Toolmaker, Tool and Die Maker or Fitter Machinist 
• 3rd or 4th year Tool making apprentices with relevant experience may also be considered
• Able to read engineering drawings and work accurately to tight tolerances
• Experience with moulds, dies, jigs, fixtures, gauges or precision tooling preferred

How to apply:
